about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm a software engineer in Toronto. I help founders who built their app with AI get it ready for real users, paying customers, or investors.
I've shipped software at startups and on production teams, so I know what breaks once people actually show up.
If you're building something, I'm happy to give you an honest, straight read during your free consultation.

items.title: System audit
items.description: I review your app and give you a written summary: what's solid, what's risky, and what to do next.

items.title: Custom development
items.description: I build what your product needs, whether that's a new feature or a custom tool made just for you.

items.title: Technical advisory
items.description: I answer your technical questions in plain English and help you decide what to build, what to skip, and what to ask your developers.

items.title: Fractional CTO
items.description: I act as your part-time technical lead: I guide the technical decisions and the team, without a full-time hire.

items.title: AI Integrations
items.description: I add AI to your product where it helps, like a chat assistant, smarter search, or an agent that handles tasks for you.
